# Tari Ootle Documentation

> Tari Ootle is a decentralized application layer built on the Tari L2 network. Templates (smart contracts) are written in Rust, compiled to WASM, and published on-chain. This documentation covers template authoring, resources, vaults, access rules, transactions, and client-side integration.

## Getting Started

- [Overview](https://ootle.tari.com/introduction/): Key concepts — templates, components, resources, vaults, buckets, transactions
- [Getting Started](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/getting-started/): Prerequisites and first steps
- [Setup a Wallet](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/setup-a-wallet/): Install and configure a wallet for publishing templates

## Concepts

- [Overview](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/overview/): The big picture — Ootle and the base layer, node roles, and finality
- [Architecture](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/architecture/): Node roles, sharding, committees, epochs, and the P2P layer
- [Consensus](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/consensus/): Chained HotStuff BFT, the three-chain rule, quorums, and cross-shard transactions
- [State and Execution](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/state-and-execution/): Substates, the Jellyfish Merkle tree, the TVM, and fees
- [Privacy](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/privacy/): Pedersen commitments, Bulletproofs+, stealth addresses, view keys, and the threat model
- [Privacy in Applications](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/privacy-in-applications/): What privacy means for a deployed application — bearer assets, HTLCs, atomic swaps, and escrow
- [Stablecoins](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/stablecoin/): Building a stablecoin from Ootle primitives — issuance, redemption, supply auditing, and the privacy boundary
- [Templates and Assets](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/templates-and-assets/): The four resource types, built-in templates, and application patterns
- [Tokenomics](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/tokenomics/): The native token, the one-way burn-to-mint bridge, and fee distribution
- [Glossary](https://ootle.tari.com/concepts/glossary/): An A–Z of the terms used across the Concepts section

## Guides

- [Templates Overview](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/template-overview/): The `#[template]` macro, constructors, state, and component lifecycle
- [Building a Guessing Game](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/build-a-guessing-game/): End-to-end walkthrough of writing a template
- [Publishing Templates](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/publishing-templates/): Compile to WASM and publish via wallet or CLI
- [Play the Guessing Game](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/play-the-guessing-game/): Interact with a published component
- [Transaction Overview](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/transaction-overview/): How transactions are constructed and executed
- [Tari CLI](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/cli/): Command-line tools for development
- [Resources](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/resources/): Fungible, non-fungible, confidential, and stealth resource types
- [Authorization and Access](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/authorization-and-access/): `rule!` macro, `ComponentAccessRules`, `OwnerRule`, `CallerContext`
- [Testing Your Template](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/testing-templates/): Unit-test templates with the template test tooling
- [Stealth Transfers](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/stealth-resources/): Private transfers — commitments, stealth addresses, and condition trees
- [API Keys for AI Agents](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/agent-api-keys/): Issue and use API keys for agent-driven wallets
- [Randomness in Templates](https://ootle.tari.com/guides/randomness/): Sources of randomness available inside a template

## Reference

- [API Overview](https://ootle.tari.com/reference/api-overview/): Full API reference for `tari_template_lib` and related crates
- [Types Reference](https://ootle.tari.com/reference/types/): `Amount`, `ComponentAddress`, `ResourceAddress`, `NonFungibleId`, and more
- [Indexer API](https://ootle.tari.com/indexer/indexer-api.html): OpenAPI docs for the Tari Indexer REST API
- [crates.io (tari_template_lib)](https://docs.rs/tari_template_lib/latest/tari_template_lib/): Rust crate documentation
